SHIPPING POLICY

We know how important it is to keep your milk supply up, so we get it – you needed your Root, like, yesterday. We offer same-day or next-day processing to get you your Root ASAP. All orders placed Monday through Friday before 3pm EST are processed the same day. Any orders placed after 3pm EST, on a national holiday, or over the weekend are processed the next business day. When your order is processed, you will receive an email notification that contains your shipment’s tracking number. Please allow up to 24 hours for your tracking number to be live in the carrier’s system. All shipments are shipped via ground transportation unless expedited shipping is selected at checkout. Please allow 5-7 business days for ground transportation deliveries and 2-3 business days for expedited shipping. 

We offer a free shipping + 10% coupon code for your first order, so be sure to grab that here [HYPERLINK TO NEWSLETTER SIGN UP]. All subscription shipments automatically qualify for free shipping (but you can still apply that 10% off on your first subscription order, so seriously, go get it before new-mom brain kicks in and you forget). 

ORDER CANCELLATIONS

We start getting your shipment ready immediately, and unfortunately, we can’t cancel or make any changes to orders that have already been processed. Reach out to support@roothelps.com ASAP to check on the status of your order and whether there’s still time to cancel or make changes. 

If you need to reschedule an upcoming subscription shipment, you can login to your account to make changes to your next shipment date. You may cancel your subscription at any time by logging into your account [HYPERLINK?] or by contacting support@roothelps.com. 

RETURN POLICY

If for any reason you are not satisfied with your purchase, you may request a refund within 15 days of delivery of your first order. We’ll refund you for the full cost of the product less shipping. Refunds apply to your first order only, not any subsequent shipments. 

While our products contain a specific blend of galactagogues (i.e., lactation support ingredients) that are considered effective for most individuals, every body responds differently to certain lactation support ingredients. 

So if you are new to lactation support supplements, or just want to see how Root works for you, we strongly recommend trying our Starter Pack. 

And as always, please consult with your healthcare professional before starting any supplements, making changes to your diet or nutrition, and regarding any interactions between our products and any medications you are taking.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

You purchased a subscription to make your life easier, good for you! If you need to make changes to your subscription, such as shipment frequency or your next shipment date, you may reschedule your subscription, including all subsequent shipments, at any time by logging in to your account [HYPERLINK TO ACCOUNT LOGIN]. You can also make changes to your account information, such as billing, shipping address and contact information, by logging into your account.

If your breastfeeding journey has come to an end—*sniff, sniff* (or, maybe, YAHOO!)—and you wish to cancel your subscription, or if you wish to cancel your subscription for any reason, you may do so at any time by logging into your account [HYPERLINK] or emailing support@roothelps.com.
